difficulty_reason: Uniqueness of the tate map c_{Y/X}: det(NL) -> omega for lqf syntomic morphisms: reformulates over the category C of lqf syntomic maps, solves on the subcategory C_nice (tau with vanishing annihilator) via affine-local gluing of the delta-to-tau isomorphisms, proves the comparison claim on morphisms by reducing to the universal examples Y_{n,d} (irreducible regular, tau nonzero by the different-ramification lemma), and extends to all of C. Retained author proof at lines 2948-3163.
